description: Build real pivot tables in Power BI, the way you already know from Excel. PivotView gives report authors and everyday business users a genuine pivot-table experience inside Power BI. Drag fields into Rows, Columns, and Values, expand and collapse hierarchies, add subtotals, filter and sort, all directly in the visual, with the polish and keyboard-friendly feel of a spreadsheet. Every feature is included free for pivots up to 100 rows. That makes it easy to evaluate PivotView on your own data, or to run smaller reports forever at no cost. A Pro license removes the row limit for your whole dataset. Why report builders love PivotView: - True drag-and-drop pivoting: rearrange Rows, Columns, and Values on the fly, right in the visual. Viewers can explore without editing the report. - Excel-familiar layouts: Compact, Outline, and Tabular; subtotals on top or bottom (or off per field); blank rows between groups; repeat item labels; grand totals that always tie out. - Fast with big data: a one-pass aggregation engine handles hundreds of thousands of rows smoothly, and loads beyond Power BI's initial data window on demand. - Rich filtering and sorting: per-field checkbox filters with search, date and numeric range filters, Top N, hide-zero rows, and per-level sorting by label or value. - Show As calculations: % of grand total, % of row/column, running totals, and more, without writing…
